Stephen Colbert’s Audience Goes Nuts For Ballsy Joke About Kevin McCarthy
The “Late Show” crowd went wild for this bit of below-the-belt humor.
By
Ed Mazza
Deputy Editor, Trends, HuffPost
Nov 16, 2023, 02:56 AM EST
LEAVE A COMMENT
LOADING
ERROR LOADING
“Late Show” host
Stephen Colbert
took a closer look at this week’s
fireworks in Congress
as multiple Republican lawmakers engaged in
insults
,
threats
and
actual physical attacks
.
In one case, Rep.
Tim Burchett
(R-Tenn.) says Rep.
Kevin McCarthy
(R-Calif.) elbowed him in the back.
Advertisement
Audio from the incident has Burchett calling out to McCarthy: “Why’d you elbow me in the back, Kevin? Hey, Kevin! You got any guts? Jerk.”
Colbert was ready with an answer.
“No, Kevin McCarthy has guts,” he said in defense of the former speaker. “What he doesn’t have is balls.”
The audience erupted at the below-the-belt joke.
